newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa House falls sharply on newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa House falls sharply on newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in Daiwa House Industry Co Ltd fell sharply on Thursday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange due to a newspaper report that its current profit is expected to shrink in the year to next March, traders said.
Daiwa House ended the morning down 90 yen at 1,330 and was the second largest percentage loser in the first section of the exchange.

Business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that Daiwa House's parent current profit for 1997/98 is expected to be 60 billion yen, or 21 percent lower than the paper's estimate of 76 billion yen for 1996/97.
A Daiwa House spokeswoman declined to comment on the report, saying the company would announce its 1997/98 earnings forecast when it unveils its 1996/97 business results in mid-May.
Daiwa House forecast in November that its 1996/97 parent current profit would be 81 billion yen.
